info.title: Fenergo Nebula Doc Gen Command
info.description:
**DocGen Command API**:
DocGen Command API provides configurational methods related to Document Generation. Use the Doc Gen Command API to create and update new and existing configuration. Use the Query API to retrieve configurations.
**DocGen Command API provides**:
  • The ability to create, update and delete configurations.
